Organic Gardening, Wildlife Conservation, and Environmental Education. 
I am Ame Vanorio, master gardener, wildlife rehabilitator, author, licensed science teacher, & environmental educator.
1. I help beginner gardeners go from growing a few vegetables to having a productive garden to provide nutritious organic food for their family/friends. I share things that have worked (and some that didn't) for me. 

2. I help wildlife lovers and rehabilitators learn more about wildlife rescue, building backyard wildlife habitat, and humane ways to protect your garden. 

3. I teach ways to connect with nature, explore wild areas, and support local eco-systems. Teacher support & lesson plans. 

We are a Safe Community. Rudeness/Trolls not tolerated. Proudly science-backed and science-positive.
Fox Run EEC is a 501c3 non-profit. A portion of the proceeds from our books, YouTube content, and affiliates is put back into our programs and used to purchase supplies for licensed wildlife rehabilitators.
